theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.79%) and Industrials (+1.21%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.98%) and Consumer Staples (-0.70%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.31%, defensives -0.45%, and value/cyclicals +0.52% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.80%, Dow +0.27%, Nasdaq +1.06% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.54%. The VIX fell 4.83% to 18.51, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.33% to $4,035.00, crude oil was little changed at $101.73, and bitcoin gained 0.24% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
